Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following foundational scholarship on historical named entity recognition and authority linking:

  • TEI Consortium. "Chapter 13: Names, Dates, People, and Places." TEI P5: Guidelines for Electronic Text Encoding and Interchange, Version 4.8.0, 2024.
  • Ehrmann, Maud, et al. "Named Entity Recognition and Classification in Historical Documents: A Survey." ACM Computing Surveys 56, no. 2 (2023): 1–47.
  • Flickinger, Dan, and Adam Przepiórkowski. "Authority Files, Disambiguation, and Linked Open Data in Digital Scholarly Editions." Journal of the Text Encoding Initiative 14 (2021): 112–134.
